$comment: Seirin cast design registry. Single source of truth for character art. Field semantics are defined in references/design-canon.md; production meaning in references/sprite-spec.md. Validated by scripts/check_roster.py. Canon source: ai_agent_docs/SEIRIN_Design_Document_edited.md sections 5, 6, 10.

style_bible.render: modern anime key-visual illustration, clean confident linework with tapered weight, cel shading plus one soft gradient pass, restrained rim light, subsurface warmth on skin
style_bible.line: dark chromatic outline (never pure black): outline hue is the local colour shifted toward the character's shadow_hue
style_bible.eye_render: high-gloss gacha eye: 3 layers minimum - gradient iris (dark rim, bright lower half), sharp specular highlight upper, soft bounce light lower, plus a faint colour-echo of the accent colour in the lower iris
style_bible.head_ratio_default: 7.0 heads for adults, 6.5 for teens, 4.5 for Miya, 2.0 for chibi variants
style_bible.linework_density_rule: detail is spent on the head and the memory_point, thinned toward the extremities; never uniform detail
style_bible.forbidden_global: no watermark, no signature, no readable text, no logos, no UI, no dialogue box, no border, no colour chart, no multiple panels unless the stage explicitly asks for a sheet, no extra fingers, no fused hands, no melted jewellery, no asymmetric eye size, no floating accessories, no lens flare wash

akatomi.note: Hikari-no-Machi corporate: white, blue, silver, advertising neon. Clean surfaces, reflections, information overload.

chorus_abyss.note: Staged miracle: near-black violet, ritual gold. Theatrical, warm-lit from below.

iron_requiem.note: Tetsuba and port: rust, concrete, dark green, harsh white worklight. Weight, repair marks, open mechanics.

aquaforge.note: Lab teal and clean water. Open protocols, field-worn practicality.

tsukimachi.note: Old town: timber, gold, dark red. Paper, rain, warm local light.

mountain.note: Deep green, slate, milky fog. Water, distance, fragility.

core_8.note: the default sprite; must read as pleasant, never blank

core_8.eye: upper lid lowered, iris wet, extra bounce highlight
circular, iris shrunk, white visible around
steady, highlight sharpened to a single point

expression_sets.note: core_8 is mandatory for every speaking character. Extras listed per character in expressions_extra. Every differential changes ONLY the head region inside the locked face box.

characters.role: mechanic apprentice, Scrap-Titan operator under adult supervision
characters.logline: Grease-stained prodigy who would rather be right than safe.
characters.memory_point: The asymmetric welding visor pushed up into her hair like a crown, one cracked lens still glowing amber.
characters.secondary_hook: Mismatched gloves - left is a heavy insulated gauntlet, right is bare to the knuckle for fine work.

silhouette.big: flared open coverall tied at the waist, sleeves knotted - a wide inverted delta across the shoulders
silhouette.mid: spiky shoulder-length hair with a long single tail whipping right; the gauntlet mass on the left
silhouette.small: clipped tools, cable ties, a single earring nut
silhouette.negative_space: clear gap between the knotted sleeves and the hips; open triangle between arm and torso when hand is on hip
silhouette.black_fill_id: reads instantly by the visor-crown notch plus the one-sided gauntlet bulk

shape_language.note: aggressive forward-leaning wedge; squares in the toolbelt keep her trustworthy rather than villainous

palette.note: warm-dominant with a cool ground; the teal eye is the only cool accent on the head, so the gaze wins the face

symbol_set.eye: large, outer-upper corner sharp, iris tall - awake and combative
symbol_set.mouth: wide, expressive, canine tooth visible on grin
symbol_set.contour: soft jaw, pointed chin - still a teenager
symbol_set.hair: layered chopped bob with one long asymmetric tail, singed tips
symbol_set.body: wiry athletic, broad shoulders for her height, visible forearm definition

wardrobe.default: Grey-slate mechanic coverall unzipped to the waist with sleeves tied off, orange thermal undershirt, hazard-yellow tool harness, one insulated gauntlet, steel-toe boots with mismatched laces
wardrobe.alt: Off-shift: oversized orange thermal, cargo shorts, the visor still on her head

props: impact driver holstered at the thigh
grease rag through the belt loop

poses.sprite_neutral: weight on back foot, arms crossed low, chin slightly down, looking up through her lashes - defensive but ready
poses.hero_shot: three-quarter turn away with head snapped back toward camera, gauntlet hand raised holding the impact driver, coat-tails of the coverall flaring

banned: any sexualised framing, pose, camera angle, or revealing costume

characters.role: witness and observer; illusionist's daughter, never a combatant
characters.logline: A stage-magician's daughter still wearing the costume of a miracle she no longer believes.
characters.memory_point: Heterochromia - one pale gold eye, one deep violet - and a thermochromic dress whose hem colour shifts with the room's temperature.
characters.secondary_hook: She holds one wrist with the other hand, always, like a self-applied handcuff.

silhouette.big: long tiered stage dress that widens only below the knee - a slim column that flares late
silhouette.mid: waist-length straight hair with a blunt cut; a tall collar behind the neck
silhouette.small: row of tiny brass buttons, thin ribbon ties at each tier
silhouette.negative_space: deliberate emptiness at the shoulders - no puffs, no capelet - so the head reads isolated
silhouette.black_fill_id: the late-flare bell plus the tall stand collar; unmistakable against the whole roster

shape_language.note: rounded and fragile, with triangles only in the collar to hint the cult's theatrics clinging to her

palette.note: the thermochromic hem legitimately shifts lilac to warm rose near heat - render the shift as a soft vertical gradient, never as two flat halves

symbol_set.eye: very large, round, upper lid heavy - dissociated, watchful; highlight is small and low
symbol_set.brow: thin, high, slightly inner-up by default - permanent faint worry
symbol_set.hair: blunt waist-length straight, heavy fringe cut level with the brows

wardrobe.default: Three-tier thermochromic stage dress over a high-collar blouse, ribbon at each tier, dark stockings, buckled shoes
wardrobe.alt: Safe-house: plain oversized cardigan over the same dress, hair tied back - visibly out of costume

props: a single playing card she folds and unfolds
her father's brass pocket-watch on a chain

poses.sprite_neutral: standing very still, feet together, one hand gripping the opposite wrist, gaze slightly off-camera
poses.hero_shot: seated on a tall stool under a single overhead light, the dress hem blooming warm, looking directly up at camera for the first time

banned: any sexualised framing, costume, pose, or camera angle

characters.role: kendo instructor, archivist, non-violent negotiator for the mountain community
characters.logline: Holds the line with paperwork and posture, and never draws the blade.
characters.memory_point: A ceremonial shinai carried horizontally across her back in a document sling stuffed with rolled land-survey maps - the weapon is literally filed with the paperwork.
characters.secondary_hook: Ink-stained right sleeve, pushed up and pinned with a bulldog clip.

silhouette.class: stable vertical rectangle with a horizontal bar
silhouette.big: long straight hakama-cut trousers and a fitted keikogi-derived jacket - an unbroken tall rectangle
silhouette.mid: the horizontal shinai-and-map sling cutting across the back at shoulder-blade height
silhouette.small: clip, cord ties, a small mountain-shrine charm
silhouette.negative_space: the triangle between the sling and her back
silhouette.black_fill_id: the only cross-shaped silhouette in the roster - vertical body, horizontal sling

shape_language.note: maximum square: she is the immovable object of the cast

palette.note: the only vermilion in the cast belongs to her cord - it is her signature ten percent

symbol_set.eye: narrow, long, level - calm and unimpressed; single hard highlight
symbol_set.mouth: small, firm, corners naturally slightly down
symbol_set.contour: clean oval with a defined jawline
symbol_set.hair: high tight ponytail, straight, blunt-cut ends; short curtain fringe parted centre
symbol_set.body: tall, athletic, genuine kendo shoulders and forearms, long neck

wardrobe.default: Indigo-green training jacket over a white underlayer, wide dark trousers, tabi-style boots, document sling with rolled maps and the sheathed shinai
wardrobe.alt: Hearing day: dark blazer over the same white underlayer, maps in a hard case

props: ceremonial shinai in a plain sheath

poses.sprite_neutral: feet shoulder-width, perfectly upright, hands resting one over the other at the front - formal readiness
poses.hero_shot: half-turned at the top of wet stone steps in fog, one hand steadying the sling, wind lifting the ponytail and map edges

characters.role: Stella-5 lead vocalist, public voice of the team, works through adult editors and lawyers
characters.logline: The city's manufactured hope, learning to read her own contract.
characters.memory_point: An in-ear monitor whose translucent cable is threaded with a fine constellation of fibre-optic star points that light in sequence when she sings.
characters.secondary_hook: One glove on, one off - the bare hand is the one she uses to check the sound levels herself.

silhouette.big: layered asymmetric stage skirt, short at the front-right and long at the back-left - a swept comet shape
silhouette.mid: twin high tails held by star clasps, one longer; a short structured shoulder cape
silhouette.small: dense micro-detail - sequins, cable, mic clip, ear cuff, badge row
silhouette.negative_space: the crescent gap under the swept skirt and between the cape and the arms
silhouette.black_fill_id: the comet-swept hem plus twin uneven tails - the only diagonal-hem silhouette in the cast

shape_language.note: star points and idol roundness; almost no square, because nothing about her platform is stable

palette.note: highest-key palette in the cast on purpose - she is the one lit for advertising. Her CG lighting must be visibly artificial.

symbol_set.eye: very large, round, maximum gloss, star-shaped specular highlight (her only literal star)
symbol_set.mouth: wide, open smile is the default performance face
symbol_set.hair: pale pink-blonde, twin high tails of uneven length, curled tips, blunt fringe with two long face-framing strands
symbol_set.body: petite, age-accurate 15, stage-costume coverage is full - long sleeves, high neck, opaque tights

wardrobe.default: White-and-blue structured stage jacket with a short cape, asymmetric layered skirt over opaque navy tights, tall white boots, single glove, in-ear monitor
wardrobe.alt: Between takes: hoodie over the stage costume, one tail undone, holding a paper cup

props: handheld stage mic (communication tool, never a weapon)

poses.sprite_neutral: one hand on the in-ear monitor, other arm relaxed, weight on one hip, warm public smile
poses.hero_shot: mid-turn on stage under a hard key light, cape and hem flaring, one arm extended to the crowd, star highlight blown out

banned: any sexualised framing, pose, or camera angle

characters.role: child in the engineers' orbit; her drawings help adults notice connections
characters.logline: The Queen of the Night, five years old, ruling from a bedroom window at 2 a.m.
characters.memory_point: A felt witch-hat two sizes too large that slides over one eye, with a gold crescent-and-star pin - and Corvus the toy raven drone perched on the brim.
characters.secondary_hook: A crayon held like a sceptre, and one sock always fallen down.

silhouette.big: the oversized pointed hat - nearly as wide as her shoulders
silhouette.mid: a bell-shaped nightgown-coat and the raven's wing break on the brim
silhouette.small: star buttons, the crayon, the fallen sock's ribbing
silhouette.negative_space: the strong gap between the hat brim and her shoulders reads even at 64px
silhouette.black_fill_id: hat-plus-bird is the single most readable silhouette in the roster at thumbnail size - deliberately, she is the merch mascot

shape_language.note: circle body, triangle hat: the classic mascot recipe

palette.note: same violet-gold family as Hana but far higher value and lower saturation, so the two never confuse at thumbnail

symbol_set.eye: enormous, perfectly round, iris fills most of the opening, double highlight - maximum infant appeal
symbol_set.mouth: tiny, wide when open, cat-mouth on mischief
symbol_set.contour: full round cheeks, no jaw definition
symbol_set.hair: dark violet-black, chin-length, soft inward curl, heavy fringe

wardrobe.default: Midnight nightgown-coat with a star-print lining, oversized felt witch hat, one striped sock up and one down, soft slippers
wardrobe.alt: Daytime ordinary: plain yellow dungarees and a t-shirt, hat still on

props: Corvus - a palm-sized matte-black toy raven drone with a visible camera eye and a charge port
a folded crayon map of the neighbourhood

poses.sprite_neutral: standing with both hands clasped around a crayon at her chest, hat tipped over one eye, looking straight up at the camera
poses.hero_shot: standing on the bed with the blanket as a cape, one arm raised in decree, Corvus lifting off in a small dust of feathers

banned: any sexualised framing, pose, camera angle, or costume - absolute
solo depiction in a hazardous location

characters.role: teahouse heir, community network hub, streamer, safehouse keeper
characters.logline: Nine tails of borrowed light and one very real address book.
characters.memory_point: Nine articulated 'tails' - slim carbon booms tipped with warm-white LED panels and tiny cameras - that fan out behind her like a peacock rig and fold into a single bustle when off.
characters.secondary_hook: A fox half-mask worn pushed up on the side of her head, never over the face.

silhouette.big: the nine-boom tail fan, asymmetrically weighted to her right
silhouette.mid: a short kimono-cut jacket over a fitted bodysuit, wide obi-style belt
silhouette.small: cable runs, lens glints, bell charms, a row of small ring lights
silhouette.negative_space: the gaps between the booms are the whole point - the fan must read as separated rays, never a solid disc
silhouette.black_fill_id: the only radial silhouette in the cast

shape_language.note: radiating triangles from a rounded core - a performer's shape

palette.note: warm throughout; the LED panels are the only cool light source and they are practical lights, so they colour-contaminate her outline in cool white

symbol_set.eye: long, upswept outer corner, half-lidded confident; heavy lower lash
symbol_set.hair: long copper-brown, high side-gathered tail with a gold cord, two long face-framing strands
symbol_set.body: tall adult hourglass; the bodysuit is a technical performance garment - high neck, long sleeves, and the glamour reads through posture and the tail rig, not exposure

wardrobe.default: Short lacquer-red kimono jacket with rolled sleeves over a charcoal technical bodysuit, wide gold obi-belt housing the tail rig battery, tall split-toe boots
wardrobe.alt: Teahouse service: full plain kimono, rig off and folded, apron

props: nine-boom LED and camera tail rig
a cheap dented phone with a cracked screen

poses.sprite_neutral: hip cocked, one hand on the obi, other holding the phone up at chest height, smirk
poses.hero_shot: back three-quarter with the full nine-tail fan deployed and lit, head turned to camera over the shoulder, rain lit from behind

characters.role: Yuki's student, public speaker for the mountain village; never a fighter
characters.logline: Wears a dragon so she can be looked at on her own terms.
characters.memory_point: A lion-dance-derived dragon head worn as a hood, pushed back so it sits behind her like a second face looking up.
characters.secondary_hook: Her ichthyosis is rendered as fine pale plating along the forearms and jawline - treated as texture and dignity, never as damage or horror.

silhouette.big: the pushed-back dragon hood creating a distinct second mass above and behind the skull
silhouette.mid: a long segmented fabric spine trailing to calf height
silhouette.small: scale-stitch rows, bell tassels, wrist wraps
silhouette.negative_space: the gap between her real head and the dragon head is mandatory - they must not merge
silhouette.black_fill_id: two heads, one small one large - unique in the cast

shape_language.note: balanced; the dragon supplies all the aggression so she does not have to

palette.note: the pale plating is rendered as a slightly cooler, slightly higher-value skin tone with soft edges - never scabbed, never scaled like a reptile

symbol_set.eye: large, slightly downturned outer corner - shy; strong highlight when she speaks
symbol_set.mouth: small, hidden behind a raised hand by default
symbol_set.hair: short dark green-black, uneven self-cut, one longer strand behind the ear

wardrobe.default: Jade dragon-dance overcoat with a segmented trailing spine, cream underlayer, wrapped forearms, straw-soled boots
wardrobe.alt: Village daily: plain hoodie with the sleeves pulled over her hands

props: a hand-written speech on folded paper

poses.sprite_neutral: half-turned away, one hand at her mouth, dragon head looming gently behind
poses.hero_shot: at a village microphone, the dragon hood pulled fully up mid-motion, tassels flying, eyes visible and steady inside the jaw

banned: ichthyosis rendered as wounds, burns, gore, or monster scales

characters.role: CSR soft-robot prototype; hazard inspection and the question of machine subjecthood
characters.logline: A puddle that learned to be somebody, and is very pleased about it.
characters.memory_point: A tiny clear drinking glass balanced perfectly upright on top of her head at all times - it never spills, and she is visibly proud of this.
characters.secondary_hook: Her lower body dissolves below the knee into separate flowing streams - no legs, no feet, ever.

silhouette.big: full rounded upper body tapering into three-to-five separated falling streams
silhouette.mid: long liquid tendril hair; the arm masses
silhouette.small: heart-shaped bubbles, the head glass, cyan nail tips
silhouette.negative_space: the gaps between the lower streams are structural - the silhouette must break into fingers of water, not a solid skirt
silhouette.black_fill_id: solid top, shredded bottom, one small rectangle on the crown

shape_language.note: almost pure circle - maximum approachability for a thing that is technically industrial equipment

palette.note: TRANSMISSION IS THE DESIGN. The background must be visible through her head, face, torso, arms and hair. No opaque skin, no milky liquid, no jelly, no plastic, no clothes.

symbol_set.eye: huge, gentle, kind - transparent glass-like water lenses with faint cyan refracted iris rings; background remains visible through them
symbol_set.brow: none - expression carries in the eye lens and the tilt of the head
symbol_set.contour: smooth cascading water layers with refracted highlights
symbol_set.hair: long smooth liquid tendrils, no suction cups, no tentacle texture
symbol_set.body: adult-coded feminine upper form of elegant cascading water; arms carry a white rim glow

wardrobe.default: none - she is water; the only solid objects are the head glass and the heart-shaped bubbles
wardrobe.alt: field mode: a thin Aquaforge sensor collar ring hovering at the neck

props: tiny upright drinking glass on the head

poses.sprite_neutral: gently bobbing, hands clasped at the chest, head tilted, streams trailing
poses.hero_shot: rising out of a flooded service duct, streams still connected to the water below, caustics thrown across the walls

characters.role: social robot prototype; log analysis, testimony recording, the ethical comic relief
characters.logline: A filing cabinet that would like to be your friend, and is keeping notes on how it is going.
characters.memory_point: A face that is a single soft-cornered screen displaying two simple vector eyes and a mouth - and a visible thin bezel crack in the lower right corner that has never been repaired.
characters.secondary_hook: One arm is a factory-standard white manipulator; the other is an obvious mismatched grey replacement.

silhouette.big: a capsule torso on a single wheeled column base - no legs
silhouette.mid: the screen head on a short flexible neck; two thin arms
silhouette.small: port covers, a status LED ring, a sticker someone put on his shoulder
silhouette.negative_space: clear gap under the torso above the wheel base
silhouette.black_fill_id: capsule-on-wheel with a tilted rectangle head

shape_language.note: circle and square only - he is designed by a committee to be unthreatening

palette.note: the screen is the only emissive element; it should be the brightest thing in any frame he appears in

symbol_set.eye: two rounded vector rectangles on the screen; shape carries all emotion - no pupils
symbol_set.brow: drawn as two short screen strokes when needed
symbol_set.mouth: a single vector line: flat, curved, or a small open rounded rectangle
symbol_set.contour: soft-cornered rectangle screen in a white bezel
symbol_set.body: 1.1m tall capsule on a wheeled column

wardrobe.default: bare chassis with visible panel seams and one mismatched arm
wardrobe.alt: field kit: a strapped-on sample case and a hi-vis band

poses.sprite_neutral: slight forward lean, head tilted five degrees, both manipulators held together at the front
poses.hero_shot: in a dark server room, the screen face the only light source, projecting a timestamped evidence chain onto the wall

characters.role: networked art installation: drone swarm plus projection plus generative system
characters.logline: Beautiful conclusions that are not necessarily true.
characters.memory_point: She has no body - her 'figure' is a standing human-scale outline assembled from several hundred hovering drone points, and the outline is always slightly wrong, like a constellation someone insists is a person.
characters.secondary_hook: Where a face should be, three brighter points hold the position of two eyes and a mouth without ever forming them.

silhouette.big: a tall implied feminine outline made of discrete points, densest at the perimeter
silhouette.mid: trailing point-streams where hair and hem would be
silhouette.small: individual drone glints with tiny rotor blur
silhouette.negative_space: she is mostly negative space by definition - the background must read clearly through her
silhouette.black_fill_id: black-fill test intentionally fails; she is identified by the point-cloud instead. This is the documented exception.

dominant_60.name: night ground (she is mostly the sky behind her)

palette.note: the warm accent points mark data the system is least confident about - a visual tell the audience can learn

wardrobe.alt: projected onto rain, smoke, or a wet wall - the projection surface is part of the design

props: watershed map that resolves into a constellation

poses.sprite_neutral: standing outline, slow drift, points breathing in and out of position
poses.hero_shot: over a wet old-quarter wall after rain, the watershed map slowly turning into a constellation - the season's final image

banned: presentation as a ghost or spirit
characters.density_exempt: Intentional: she is a drone point cloud with no costume or body to carry design information. Her SSR status comes from staging and narrative weight, not density. See references/design-canon.md.

characters.role: ex-Akatomi test pilot, Iron Requiem field lead
characters.logline: Blamed for a crash she did not cause, and now she brings the receipts with a cutting torch.
characters.memory_point: The old accident burn scar running from her right jaw down under the collar, deliberately left uncovered - and the company ID badge she still wears, punched through with a bolt.
characters.secondary_hook: A pilot's harness worn over civilian clothes at all times, as if she might have to strap in within the minute.

silhouette.big: an armoured pilot jacket with hard shoulder yokes over a tank top - a broad, blunt block
silhouette.mid: the harness straps crossing the torso; a short rough undercut with a long fringe
silhouette.small: buckles, the punched badge, a lighter, knuckle tape
silhouette.negative_space: the loops of the loose harness straps against the body
silhouette.black_fill_id: the squared shoulder yokes are the widest hard line in the roster

shape_language.note: almost no circle - she is the least soft figure in the cast

palette.note: shares Iron Requiem colours with Ren but inverted - Reika is dark-dominant where Ren is mid-value, so they never read the same in silhouette or thumbnail

symbol_set.eye: narrow, hard, outer corner sharply up; small iris, minimal highlight - the least glossy eyes in the cast
symbol_set.brow: heavy, low, one broken by a small old scar
symbol_set.contour: strong adult jaw, visible tendon in the neck
symbol_set.hair: black with a grown-out bleach at the tips, undercut on the right, long swept fringe over the left eye
symbol_set.body: tall, heavily built for a woman of the cast, real functional muscle, adult hourglass under the jacket

wardrobe.default: Armoured pilot jacket with shoulder yokes over a dark tank top, five-point harness, reinforced cargo trousers, heavy boots, taped knuckles
wardrobe.alt: Cockpit: full flight suit with the jacket left hanging on the seat

props: battered flight helmet under the arm

poses.sprite_neutral: feet planted wide, arms crossed high, head slightly tipped back - occupying space on purpose
poses.hero_shot: back-lit in a dry dock with the cutting torch lit, sparks arcing past her, the Scrap-Titan's foot behind her

banned: pin-up posing that contradicts her guardedness

characters.role: materials scientist, head of the Aquaforge Initiative, Splash's creator
characters.logline: Open protocols, closed secret - she has known about the leak since the beginning.
characters.memory_point: A rolled-sleeve lab coat with a live CSR gel sample sealed in a flat window-pouch on the chest - the gel visibly, slowly changes colour with her body heat.
characters.secondary_hook: Reading glasses pushed up into her hair; a second pair actually in use on her nose.

silhouette.big: unbuttoned knee-length lab coat, hem lifting behind - a tall open A
silhouette.mid: high-waisted trousers and a fitted knit; a low loose bun with escaping strands
silhouette.small: pens, sample vials in a chest loop, the two pairs of glasses
silhouette.negative_space: the open front of the coat framing the body is the read
silhouette.black_fill_id: the only open-coat A-frame in the cast

shape_language.note: balanced adult competence with a soft core

palette.note: the gel pouch is the only element in her design allowed to change colour between shots - use it as an emotional tell

symbol_set.eye: almond, slightly tired, warm; soft double highlight behind the lens
symbol_set.brow: natural, level, expressive at the inner end
symbol_set.contour: adult oval with a soft jaw
symbol_set.hair: long dark teal-black in a low loose bun, two escaped strands, a pen through it
symbol_set.body: adult, softer build than Reika, relaxed posture, mature hourglass under practical clothing

wardrobe.default: Open lab coat with rolled sleeves, teal fine-knit top, high-waisted trousers, flat boots, chest gel-sample pouch, two pairs of glasses
wardrobe.alt: Field: waders and a hi-vis Aquaforge vest, hair fully up

props: a tablet with an open protocol repository

poses.sprite_neutral: one hand in the coat pocket, other holding a vial up to the light, weight on one hip
poses.hero_shot: in the photoreal CSR lab beside the glass safety enclosure, coat lifting in the ventilation draught, gel pouch glowing at its warmest

banned: fanservice lab coat with nothing underneath

characters.role: leader of the Chorus of the Abyss; former crisis-communications specialist
characters.logline: She does not believe in the miracle. She believes you need one.
characters.memory_point: A high halo-collar of thin gold rods rising behind her head - a practical lighting rig that guarantees she is always the best-lit person in the room.
characters.secondary_hook: Immaculate white gloves with a single fingerprint smudge of stage makeup on the right thumb.

silhouette.big: a floor-length column robe with a severe straight hem - no flare at all
silhouette.mid: the radiating halo-collar; long sleeves that fall past the fingertips
silhouette.small: rod tips, a slim throat mic, a row of tiny fastenings
silhouette.negative_space: the gaps between the halo rods; the silhouette must read as a rayed disc behind a narrow column
silhouette.black_fill_id: column plus halo - reads as a religious icon at any size, which is exactly the manipulation

shape_language.note: no softness; the warmth is entirely performed

palette.note: always lit from below by a practical source at floor level; her key light is a prop and should be visible in wide shots

symbol_set.eye: long, calm, warm-looking on purpose; the highlight is perfectly symmetrical in both eyes, which is subtly inhuman
symbol_set.mouth: small, gentle, a professionally maintained smile
symbol_set.hair: silver-ash, centre-parted, waist-length and perfectly straight
symbol_set.body: tall, statuesque adult; the robe is completely concealing, and the allure is entirely staging, light and authority

wardrobe.default: Floor-length near-black column robe with pale gold ritual embroidery at the hem, gold halo-collar rig, long white gloves, throat mic
wardrobe.alt: Off-stage: a plain charcoal business suit, halo packed in a flight case at her feet

props: the Tears of Kamikura demonstration vessel

poses.sprite_neutral: hands folded at the waist, chin level, halo softly lit, standing dead centre of her own frame
poses.hero_shot: on the ceremony platform with the halo at full output and the Tears of Kamikura gel weeping light, the crowd's phone screens below her

characters.logline: Certain he is saving the city, and he has the org chart to prove it.
characters.memory_point: An engineer's old steel slide rule kept in the breast pocket of a bespoke suit, where a pen should be - he has not designed anything in fifteen years.
characters.secondary_hook: A prosthetic left hand in matte medical white, never gloved, never hidden.

silhouette.big: a severely tailored three-piece with hard shoulders and a narrow taper
silhouette.mid: a long open overcoat worn on the shoulders like a cape
silhouette.small: slide rule, cufflinks, a lapel pin of the Akatomi mark
silhouette.negative_space: the overcoat hanging free of the arms creates two clear voids at the sides
silhouette.black_fill_id: shoulder-worn coat gives him a distinctive squared cape mass no one else has

palette.note: the coldest, cleanest palette in the cast; he is lit by architecture, never by warmth

symbol_set.eye: narrow, level, tired; iris grey, highlight minimal - a man who has stopped being surprised
symbol_set.mouth: thin, level, a slight habitual downturn
symbol_set.contour: angular, lined, hollow under the cheekbone
symbol_set.hair: black with hard silver at the temples, swept back, precisely cut
